u18-rollback-rehearsal.title: Rehearse U18-S then U18 rollback on a disposable chain; prove clean removal and clean re-apply
u18-rollback-rehearsal.cmd: Local disposable Postgres only (container name must start cf1pilot-, removed at the end). Run the reviewed script phase2/scripts/run_u18s2.sh fetched from refs/heads/main (verify its sha256 equals 410b1ee68a0ab6a1949571f9932af4fedf499250cd7f9eb9246f8e6b8acb6bb8 before running; do not run any other copy) as: KEEP=1 SUITES=none IMG=ns1-base:snap bash <script> cf1pilot-q1 both <outfile>; then apply the U18-S rollback and the U18 rollback from the df-u18pkg release package, assert the objects, trigger privileges and functions are restored, then re-apply forward cleanly.
u18-rollback-rehearsal.done: Evidence note in the df-u18pkg worktree (docs/qa/cf1-u18-package/rollback-rehearsal.md) with before/after catalog checks; container removed; no hosted system touched; the evidence note records `git rev-parse HEAD` of the df-u18s and df-u18 worktrees whose SQL was applied, and the container is removed with docker rm -f -v

u18-tooling-residual-check.title: Verify pg_dump/pg_restore, COPY and MERGE behaviour with client TRIGGER privilege revoked (documented U18 residual)
u18-tooling-residual-check.cmd: Local disposable Postgres only (container name must start cf1pilot-, removed at the end). Build the chain with the reviewed script phase2/scripts/run_u18s2.sh fetched from refs/heads/main (verify its sha256 equals 410b1ee68a0ab6a1949571f9932af4fedf499250cd7f9eb9246f8e6b8acb6bb8 before running; do not run any other copy) as: KEEP=1 SUITES=none IMG=ns1-base:snap bash <script> cf1pilot-q2 both <outfile>; then exercise pg_dump --data-only/restore, COPY FROM and MERGE against event_competition_heat_entries as the owner and as client roles.
u18-tooling-residual-check.done: Evidence appended to docs/qa/cf1-u18-package/tooling-residual-check.md: which paths the guards cover, which they do not; container removed; no hosted system touched; the evidence note records `git rev-parse HEAD` of the df-u18s and df-u18 worktrees whose SQL was applied, and the container is removed with docker rm -f -v

release-migration-inventory.title: Git-only: Competition migrations on the release branch with sha256 pins and dependency order (no hosted queries)
release-migration-inventory.cmd: git read-only commands (ls-tree, show, cat-file, log, rev-parse) on origin/release/competition-cf1-app-candidate and origin/main; compute sha256 per migration file; derive apply order from the file names and the existing release docs. No database access of any kind: the comparison with PROD migration history is done by the coordinator outside the loop.
release-migration-inventory.done: Inventory doc docs/qa/cf1-competition-migration-inventory-2026-11-14.md in the df-u18pkg worktree (local commit only): list, sha256 pins, required order, owner-gate checklist with a "PROD history comparison pending" column; no hosted access
